paper_title: Measurement of light-by-light scattering and search for axion-like particles with 2.2 nb$^{-1}$ of Pb+Pb data with the ATLAS detector
notes: ATLAS light-by-light scattering search for axion-like particles in Pb+Pb UPC, 2.2 nb^-1. Sets 95% CL limits on gamma-gamma -> a -> gamma-gamma for ALP masses 6-100 GeV. Coupling reported as 1/Lambda_a ranging from 0.3 TeV^-1 (0.06 TeV^-1) = 3e-4 GeV^-1 (6e-5 GeV^-1). Only endpoint values available from text (Figure 9 not tabulated); intermediate point at ~10 GeV is an interpolation/estimate. This is a collider bound (not DM haloscope) so no local DM density. Cross-section limits 70 nb to 2 nb.
